headline: Heat warning over — harvest beans and onions this week.
weather_notes: Work outdoors before 10 AM today — 97°F afternoon with 40% storm chance after noon closes the safe outdoor window early.
Run both zones Tuesday morning if today's storms don't bring measurable rain — zones last ran Aug 9; Tuesday's 96°F puts beds 2 days past the 1-day heat re-water threshold.
Target Wednesday morning for heavier garden tasks — 90°F forecast is the week's coolest daytime high with storm systems providing a viable work window.
Shade e1–e4 tomato beds by 11 AM today and tomorrow — Phoenix harvest opens Aug 24 and 96–97°F through Tuesday sustains sunscald risk.

surfaced_tasks.title: Tip new blackberry primocanes if 3–4 ft tall
surfaced_tasks.reason: 31 days overdue — Extreme Heat Warning expired overnight; today's early morning is the first safe outdoor window in weeks.

suggested_tasks.title: Harvest c2/c3/c4 beans — past peak
suggested_tasks.description: Jade Bush and Red Swan Bush planted May 28 are 74 days in — 17–24 days past their 50–57-day window; harvest before pods toughen or dry out completely.

suggested_tasks.title: Pull soft-necked w4 onions before rot sets in
suggested_tasks.description: Super Star and Yellow Sweet Spanish at 107 days are deep in their maturity window — squeeze necks and pull any soft bulbs before Tuesday's 96°F accelerates post-maturity rot.
